objective: Evaluate one fixed relative guard over frozen hard_h4:factory_035 without retuning.

candidate.endpoint: S = raw_valid & aligned_validity & warp_support; V(x) = isfinite(x) & (x > 0); accepted = S & V(raw) & V(hard035) & (raw / 2 <= hard035) & (hard035 <= 2 * raw); disparity = where(accepted, hard035, raw)

development_gate.aggregation: macro_sequence mean over nine backbone-keyframe reports

invariants: No ground truth, backbone identity, future frame, or retuning enters the adapter.
Raw-invalid values are returned as raw; the guard does not rescue them.
Only the existing raw_valid & aligned_validity & warp_support mask is used.
Endpoint, ratio boundaries, invalid values, support, dtype/shape, factory, and driver-state propagation are unit tested.

ood_gate.comparison: paired canonical and candidate on identical recording/support

stop_rule: One candidate only: no other kappa, recording, or retuning.
